text:
maria: Heads-up — we'll swap the adaptive-batch kernel onto the standby stack tonight 00:30–01:30 UTC. Plan: push quant-2.2 artifacts, staggered drain (10% -> 30% -> 60%), smoke at each step, hold 10% for 15m before widening.
sam: Who's owning the rollout? I can take the first window.
maria: thanks — sam owns rollout. jen will watch telemetry and perf dashboards. liam will be on rollback pager.
jen: I'll patch release notes with perf expectations and known regressions. Suggest adding "kv-cache hit rate" and "p99 decode latency" baselines.
vijay: Are we pinning the previous kernel for 2h after deploy in case of quick rollback? @deploybot, can you add a sticky pin if needed?
deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled rollout: image=adaptive-batch:v4 quant=quant-2.2 window=00:30-01:30 UTC. will apply canary slice=10% -> 30% -> 60%. pin TTL=0 by default.
maria: Set pin TTL=2h for this release. Manual rollback triggers: >5% error increase OR p99 > baseline + 35ms for two consecutive slices.
jen: Noted. I'll publish a short smoke checklist in the release notes: 1) smoke generate on 512-long prompt 2) embedding checksum 3) kv-cache warmup rates.
liam: If we need to rollback, we'll flip to adaptive-batch:v3 (last-stable). Who has the image tag?
sam: I pushed v4 to gcr yesterday. v3 is still in staging. tagging v3->last-stable now.
sam: tag done: gcr.redwood/adaptive-batch:last-stable -> digest sha256:abcd1234
maria: Run preflight now? Canary metric sanity: run the canary job with short prompts. jen, can you confirm crash-free?
jen: Running now. quick logs: no OOMs, decode p95 ~ baseline + 4ms. kv-hit initial 62% (expected 60-65%). no obvious errors.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] smoke job #4578 completed: pass=4 fail=0.
vijay: Good. Schedule looks green. Reminder: change window extended +30m if post-smoke anomalies need triage. Otherwise proceed per plan.
sam: Starting 10% slice rollout in 10m. I'll ping when slice increments.
maria: Adding release-note blurb: "Adaptive-batch:v4 improves throughput for batched short-sequence workloads; expected median latency unchanged. Quant v2.2 improves token quality for small models." I'll commit to docs after deploy.
deploybot: [deploybot] canary 10% started by sam at 3445012950.
sam: Canary ok. p99 +12ms, errors flat.
maria: Proceeding to 30%.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=30% started.
sam: 30% looks fine. p99 +18ms, errors +0.7%. Holding 15m.
jen: Telemetry green. publishing notes now.
vijay: No regression. We'll widen after hold.
sam: Widening to 60% now.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=60% started.
sam: All good. Final widen scheduled at 01:00 UTC.
maria: Thanks team. Post-deploy actions: create postmortem if any alert > critical or manual rollback. Otherwise close release and tag release-notes done.
